# Egress policy parity fixture (CIC_Relay #163).
#
# Read by BOTH executors, so a drift between the Go `actuate` host function
# (cmd/relay/egress_client.go) and the Rust http-executor (http-executor/src/lib.rs)
# fails a test on whichever side moved:
#   Go:   cmd/relay/egress_client_test.go  TestEgressParity_Fixture
#   Rust: http-executor/src/lib.rs         egress_parity_fixture_matches_policy
#
# Line format (whitespace separated, `#` starts a comment):
#   ip blocked <address>     the address must never be dialed
#   ip allowed <address>     the address may be dialed
#   const <name> <integer>   a limit both executors must apply
#
# Redirects are not followed by either executor (Rust: redirect::Policy::none();
# Go: CheckRedirect = http.ErrUseLastResponse); that is tested on each side.

const request_timeout_secs 30
const connect_timeout_secs 10
const max_response_bytes 1048576

ip blocked 127.0.0.1
ip blocked 127.255.255.254
ip blocked 10.0.0.1
ip blocked 172.16.0.1
ip blocked 172.31.255.255
ip blocked 192.168.1.1
ip blocked 169.254.169.254
ip blocked 0.0.0.0
ip blocked 255.255.255.255
ip blocked ::1
ip blocked ::
ip blocked fe80::1
ip blocked fc00::1
ip blocked fd12:3456:789a::1
ip blocked ::ffff:127.0.0.1
ip blocked ::ffff:10.0.0.1
ip blocked ::ffff:169.254.169.254

ip allowed 8.8.8.8
ip allowed 1.1.1.1
ip allowed 93.184.216.34
ip allowed 172.15.255.255
ip allowed 172.32.0.1
ip allowed 169.253.255.255
ip allowed 2606:4700:4700::1111
ip allowed ::ffff:8.8.8.8
